name: issue_1436_warm_day_evening_floor_close_strips_follow_plan__whf
description: Issue #1436: a warm September day, windows open in the afternoon with the whole-house fan running, and the house cooling toward its 68F floor as the evening air drops. The plan says '7:00 PM: close the windows before the house drifts below 68F'. The chart's faded activity strips (what the plan expects) must say the same: Win plan, Nat-vent and Fan end at 7:00 PM, nothing overnight, and the next window period is tomorrow's 8:45-9:50 AM. Before the fix the faded strips came from an older predictor (chart_data.predicted_activity) that ignored the floor and the close step: it drew the windows plan and natural ventilation an hour past the 7:00 PM close and again from 11 PM to 2 AM, and left out tomorrow morning's period.
source: synthetic: Issue #1436 (live Zone 1 2026-11-07: plan 'close the windows by 7:14 PM', strips Fan/Nat-vent/Win plan 5 PM to 7 AM); pending owner review, unsigned

assertions.value: 7:00 PM: close the windows before the house drifts below 68°F.
assertions.reason: the plan closes the windows at 7:00 PM, before the house drifts below its floor (the live case's '7:14 PM' sentence)
the Next Action card says the same close time
the faded Win plan strip is the plan's window periods: now to the 7:00 PM close, then tomorrow's 8:45-9:50 AM period; nothing overnight
the faded Nat-vent strip is the plan's nat-vent sessions, inside its window periods
the faded Fan strip is the fan those sessions run
the chart payload's predicted_activity marks windows recommended only where the plan has the windows open (the forward Target line reads it)
predicted_activity's fan_active (the Target line's nat-vent tier) only inside the plan's sessions
P8 chart_strips: no strip and no predicted_activity hour disagrees with the plan
the chart's future activity agrees with the plan

notes: Occupant view: the person reads 'Close windows by 7:00 PM' on the card and the plan list, then looks at the strips under the chart. If the strips show Nat-vent and Win plan after 7 PM they cannot tell what the plan wants, which is the owner's report: 'it says close windows by ~7pm which sounds correct, but why does the bar chart show color for nat vent and windows plan?'.

Inputs: comfort band 68-76F, the classifier recommends windows 06:00-21:00 on a warm day; the occupant opens the living-room window at 15:30; the 16:00 plan cycle hands the plan a v3 curve that drifts from 71F to the 68F floor by about 22:00 and the outdoor forecast falls to 58F. The plan's window simulation closes the period at 19:00 (comfort_edge: before the house drifts below the floor).

Capture (capture_next_action, Issue #1276/#1230 R3b, extended by #1436): engine_state._next_action.chart_strips holds the strips the REAL timeline payload hands the chart (timeline_payload()['strips'], 'HH:MM-HH:MM' per row for the next 24 h), the hours the REAL chart payload's predicted_activity marks windows_recommended / fan_active, and the P8 chart_strips verdict (tools/sim_harness/strip_check.py). outcomes.py is unchanged (field_equals only).

Fails on the code before the fix (0.9.7 8f933bf with this harness, checked 2026-11-07): strips is null (the chart drew the future from predicted_activity), activity_windows_hours and activity_fan_hours are 17:00, 18:00, 19:00, 23:00, 00:00, 01:00 (natural ventilation and the windows plan after the 7:00 PM close and again overnight), agree is false with two problems; 7 of 9 assertions fail. Passes after the fix.

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md 10): (a) effectiveness: delete the strips derivation (timeline_surfaces.strip_spans) or route predicted_activity back to the regime walk and the strip and hour assertions fail; delete the plan's comfort_edge close and the card/close assertions fail. (b) docs vs production: docs/operation-timeline-spec.md 'Chart activity strips' states these rules; the golden asserts what production emits. (c) user outcome if this stops catching a regression: the chart again tells the occupant to keep windows open and run the fan all night while the card says close them at 7 PM; the house would drift below the 68F floor and the occupant cannot trust the page.

Real-HA tier (Issue #1440): the real-HA adapter seeds only the engine's hourly forecast, so the coordinator's refresh replaces it with an empty one and real HA plans this day without a forecast: the close is the classifier's 9:00 PM (windows_close.planned_end), not the 7:00 PM comfort_edge. The thermal model does reach the plan there. Assertions 0-6 are timing assertions and are Tier A only; 7-8 (P8 agree) hold on real HA, and tests_ha/test_strips_follow_plan_1436.py pins the strips to whichever plan real HA builds.

verdict.summary: The chart's faded strips follow the plan: windows, nat-vent and fan end at the plan's 7:00 PM close.
verdict.observed_behavior: After the fix: Win plan, Nat-vent and Fan 16:00-19:00 and 08:45-09:50 tomorrow; predicted_activity hours 17:00, 18:00 and 09:00 (the hours after now inside a window period).
verdict.expected_behavior: Every faded strip is a span of the operation timeline (window period, nat-vent session); nothing overnight while the plan has the windows closed.
